note: What the build cost on the day the gate was written, before any fix landed. Every number here is a browser measurement from tests/e2e/studio-runtime-cost.mjs; none is a target. Targets live in src/lib/studioRuntimeBudgets.ts, and every window below is red against them today.

machine.server: Studio Vite dev server on http://localhost:5190

caveat: The dev server is not the build users run. These numbers are a regression signal and the baseline the fixes are measured against, not a product claim.
runToRunVariance: A repeat run of the fixture arm reproduced every window: idle 60.0 recalcs/s and 13.5% of a core, scrub 157 queries, open 8.38x, switch 0.38 MB per cycle. Counting assertions repeat exactly; CPU fraction, byte totals and heap slope move by a few percent.

fixture.what: Generated by tests/e2e/generateStudioLoadFixture.mjs into data/projects/ (gitignored). studio-runtime-cost-a: 133 clips, 12 tracks, 20 media sources, 140 media clips (7 clips per source). studio-runtime-cost-b: 90 clips, 15 sources, 105 media clips.

realProject.what: eliana-montage (273 clips: 77 video, 23 audio, 263 images) alternating with biweekly-2026-07-31 (35 clips). Not in the repo; symlinked into data/projects/ for this capture. Recorded so the fixture arm can be trusted to stand in for a real project.

agreementWithTheProblemFrame.idleBacklogThenSteadyState: Reproduced. The real project's first window carries 129 layouts and 56% of a core; every window after it has ZERO layouts and a flat recalc count. A fixed sleep would have gated on the first window.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.idleStyleRecalcRate: Reproduced: 111.8/s measured against 120/s in the Problem Frame — two per frame at 60fps.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.idleCpu: 27.1% of a core measured against 16-17% in the Problem Frame. Same order, not the same number: this capture is headless Chrome against a Vite dev server. The deterministic counts agree; the CPU fraction is environment-sensitive, which is why the gate carries a constrained tier.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.idleCallSites: Reproduced exactly: SnapGuideOverlay, useDomEditOverlayRects, useDomEditCompositionRect, offCanvasIndicatorRefresh in the Studio document, plus transportTick and the GSAP ticker inside the preview iframe.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.scrub: Every full-document media query happens inside the preview iframe; the Studio document issues none. Roughly three to four per drag step.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.openAmplification: Reproduced: 79 distinct media sources and 264 distinct images on the real project, matching the Problem Frame's 79 and 263. The request ratio measured 5.5x against 4.3x reported.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.openBytes: 233.8 MB measured against 534.6 MB reported. This gate sums CDP encodedDataLength — bytes actually moved over the wire — so requests served from the browser cache contribute nothing. The request COUNT (1,771 against 1,737) agrees closely, so the difference is accounting, not behaviour.
agreementWithTheProblemFrame.switchRetention: Reproduced: monotonic heap growth of 0.31 MB per cycle on the real project and 0.43 MB on the fixture, against ~0.5 MB reported, with nodes, listeners and documents flat.

verdictToday: All four windows fail. idle CPU 13.6% vs 1% budget; idle recalcs 60/s vs 5/s; idle animation-frame calls 303/s vs 5/s; scrub 157 full-document media queries vs 0; open 8.13x per distinct media source vs 1.2x; switch 0.41 MB per cycle vs 0.10 MB.
